about_the_game:
This is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. All you need to do is use the mouse to drag the pieces to the correct positions, and when you complete the puzzle and form a complete picture, you can unlock the picture gallery.

Gameplay:

■ Drag the fragments with the mouse and swap their positions with other fragments.

■ Just push all the pieces into the correct positions to complete the puzzle.

■ You can click the icon at the bottom right of the game to temporarily view the full image.

Game Features:

■ Cute style + soothing music

■ Programmatic automated cutting and assembling of puzzles

■ Optional Difficulty Level

■ A total of 36 pictures are available for selection
